note: Both sets contain the same nine claims with identical content and identical errors: four beam descriptions are paired with the wrong keynote mark (FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 6 given as A4 instead of A1, FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 2 as A1 instead of A4, FLOOR BEAM NEAR GRID 5 as B4 instead of B1, FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 3 as B1 instead of B4). The W10X15/W8X13 section assignments and the 1/2" opening edge radius are correct in both. The only difference is that B states the radius condition more fully ('around edges of openings in beams' vs A's 'around edges'), which is a marginal fidelity edge but not enough to separate them. Both also omit the ø3" circular openings shown in the W8X13 roof beams and the E6 mark for the roof beam at grids 2,3,4,5.
remarks: The keynote mark/description pairs in the SHEET KEYNOTES block are consistently swapped between the two columns in both extractions (A4/A1 and B4/B1), suggesting a systematic row-alignment failure in both pipelines. Both sets also miss the ø3" round openings shown in the W8X13 roof beam details (C1 and E6) and the E6 mark itself; 'T.O. STEEL' is part of the E6 description text, not really a condition. The numerous opening dimensions in the eight beam detail views are omitted by both sets.
